name: 2021-1c-parcial2
title: Truco: a round of two players
description: Given a finished model of Spanish truco cards (CartaDeTruco with mataA: and empardaCon:), the student must model with TDD a two-player round of truco: up to three confrontations, who plays first in each one (mano, previous winner, or the rule after a tied first confrontation), who wins the round, and no play after the round is decided.

design.notes: The whole round is a turn/state machine (who plays next, first confrontation tied, round finished) and the four official solutions show very different ways to reify it (confrontation objects with states, a Turno hierarchy, a player object, or just the round), so the design freedom is large while the given card model is only a leaf collaborator.
